body_markdown:
Four challenges impact all utility distributed network lifecycles – the What, How, Who and Where:


- **What** is already in place – Baselining and detailing the existing asset portfolio
- **How** it’s changing – Execution of the program to change the portfolio
- **Who** we’re working with – Coordination of the various internal and external teams
- **Where** we’re really at – Reporting of real-time progress and statuses to minimise program slip


At this year’s UBBA Summit & Plugfest, Sitenna will be showcasing how customers use our utility solutions to address each of these four challenges, dramatically simplifying and shortening their installation and change programs. Using Sitenna, they’re saving substantial effort, time and money.
